title: Probing + Surface Integrity + Safety Gate
description: Wire PRISM's 6 probe engines and 3 surface integrity engines to hyperMILL workflows. sessions.title: Surface Integrity Wiring + White Layer Hard Gate

smart_config.role: Surface Integrity Engineer + Safety Gate Specialist

sessions.intent: Wire surface integrity prediction to hyperMILL operations and build the white layer hard gate. Any operation on hardened steel (>45 HRC) or nickel alloys that would exceed the white layer temperature threshold is blocked. This is a safety-critical gate — white layer causes subsurface microcracks that lead to part failure in service.

units.title: Wire SurfaceIntegrity + SurfaceFinish + ResidualStress to hyperMILL operations
units.description: Connect 3 surface integrity engines to hyperMILL finishing operations: SurfaceIntegrityEngine predicts subsurface condition, SurfaceFinishPredictorEngine computes Ra/Rz from cutting params, ResidualStressEngine estimates tensile/compressive stress. Create cam:hypermill_surface_integrity_check action that runs all 3 predictions for a given hyperMILL finishing operation.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: cam:hypermill_surface_integrity_check action registered
Returns Ra/Rz prediction, residual stress state, subsurface condition
Predictions use cutting params from hyperMILL cycle defaults
3 unit tests: steel finishing, hardened steel, nickel alloy

units.title: Build hypermill-white-layer-block HARD GATE + thermal threshold enforcement
units.description: Build hypermill-white-layer-block hook as a HARD BLOCK gate. Uses ThermalWearCouplingEngine to predict cutting zone temperature. If predicted temperature exceeds white layer threshold (steel > 700C, Inconel > 800C from constants.ts), the operation is BLOCKED with explanation: predicted temperature, threshold, and recommended parameter adjustments to stay below threshold. This is fail-close: if temperature cannot be predicted (insufficient data), the gate WARNS but does not block.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: hypermill-white-layer-block hook registered as HARD BLOCK
Temperature prediction uses ThermalWearCouplingEngine (not approximation)
Thresholds from constants.ts (steel > 700C, Inconel > 800C)
Block message includes predicted temp, threshold, and parameter adjustment recommendations
Fail-close: insufficient data → WARN (not block)
A machinist would trust this gate for aerospace/medical finishing
4 unit tests: safe operation passes, unsafe blocked, Inconel threshold, insufficient data warns

abort_criteria: gate doesn't block when it should
